decisions.reason: As a basic cleaning product tightly tied to the installed base of the firm's wood floors, it remains easy to support with existing product knowledge, channels, and customer learning.
Maintenance oil still fits closely with the firm's surface-treatment know-how, and the several models allow continued refinement through installer feedback and in-house R&D.
The moisture-protection underlay complements the core flooring system and can be improved and sold through the firm's established technical guidance and project-sales capabilities.
High-density underlay foam is related to the firm's accessory business but is more standardised and easier to substitute, so it stays with a somewhat higher withdrawal risk than core lines.
The oak parquet line is very close to the firm's core wood-processing, design, and flooring competences, giving high absorptive capacity and a strong case for continuation.
